name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Stand between two low pulleys and take the opposite handle in each hand so the cables cross in front of you.
Let your hands rest near the opposite thighs with your elbows softly bent.
Sweep your arms out and slightly forward until they reach shoulder height.
Guide your hands down along the same arcs.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows as your shoulder blades turn upward.
Avoid swinging your torso or lifting your hands above shoulder height.
